weather.title: Weather

weather.autoHint: Uses your location to fetch live conditions. Falls back to a seasonal estimate if unavailable.

zodiac.title: Zodiac (optional)
zodiac.subtitle: A small, playful touch — never the main decision.

fitCheck.title: Fit Check
fitCheck.subtitle: Upload a full-body photo and get an honest read on the look.
fitCheck.analysisError: We couldn’t analyze this photo right now. Try again, or retake the photo.
fitCheck.lowConfidence: I can't assess this clearly from this photo. Try one front-facing, well-lit full-body shot.
fitCheck.enhanceHint: Fit Check analyzes the original full-body frame — no beauty filter or crop is applied before analysis.
fitCheck.showItOnMeDescription: Photo-preview try-on isn't configured in this build yet — the provider hook is ready in services/providers/ai for whenever an image-generation vendor is wired up.
fitCheck.detectedPiecesHint: Only clearly visible pieces are listed. Review and edit metadata in My closet after adding.

tailor.title: Tailor mode
tailor.instructions: Bring this screen to your tailor — it summarizes the qualitative adjustment to check on you.
tailor.measureOnPerson: Exact measurements should be taken by the tailor while the garment is on you.
tailor.missingBody: This screen only opens from an ADJUST Fit Check with valid tailor advice. Run Fit Check again.

camera.savedDefaultBody: This filter and intensity will be pre-selected next time.

closet.title: My closet
closet.empty: Your closet is empty — add a few pieces to unlock closet-based recommendations.
closet.analysisFailed: I could not identify this item clearly. Try a brighter photo with one item in frame.
closet.deleteBody: This removes the item and its stored photo from this device.
closet.aiMetadataHint: AI suggests the first metadata. You can edit it afterward.
closet.metadataTruthNote: AI labels are a starting point. Edit category, color, brand or tags whenever they are wrong.
closet.editTruthNote: Your corrections override the AI label and improve future closet-based decisions.

store.title: Store mode
store.decisionHint: Describe the item. AI Beauty checks your closet first and avoids pretending it knows live stock or prices.
store.productPlaceholder: Item, color and cut — e.g. black cropped blazer
store.closetEmpty: Your closet is empty, so duplicate checking is limited.
store.needDescription: Add a clear product description before deciding.
store.duplicateReason: You appear to own a very similar piece already. Skip unless this replaces something worn out or fills a specific fit need.
store.noClosetReason: There is not enough closet data yet for a confident buy decision. Consider it, but compare fit and versatility first.
store.considerReason: No obvious duplicate was found. Consider it only if it works with at least three pieces you already own and fits your real budget.
store.truthfulNote: This is a closet-based decision aid, not a live store-stock or price claim.
store.compatibleCount: Works with about {{count}} closet pieces based on current metadata.

reason.duplicate: You already appear to own a very similar piece. Skip unless it replaces something worn out.
reason.over_budget: This is above the budget ceiling you entered, so skip it for now.
reason.disliked_color: The description matches a color you marked as disliked. Skip unless you intentionally want to revisit that preference.
reason.versatile: No obvious duplicate was found and it appears versatile with your closet.
reason.favorite_color: It matches one of your favorite colors, but still check fit and real need.
reason.trend_support: A verified trend signal supports it, but trend never overrides your taste or budget.
reason.stale_trend_support: Only older dated trend data supports it; treat that as context, not current fashion proof.
reason.consider: There is not enough evidence for a confident buy. Compare fit, need and versatility first.
reason.rejected_history: This resembles looks you previously rejected. Skip unless your preference has changed.
reason.loved_history: This echoes looks you previously loved; use that as a preference signal, not a reason to buy by itself.

store.photoAnalysisUnavailable: Photo analysis is unavailable right now. You can still decide from the description; no visual result is being invented.
store.compatibilityMeaning: This score estimates how easily the item can work with pieces you already own. It is not a fit guarantee.

profile.title: Profile
profile.accountLocalOnly: This account is stored on this device only.
profile.accountSynced: Signed in. Your style profile, photos, wardrobe and Saved Looks remain on this device in this build.
profile.guestNotice: You're browsing as a guest. Sign in to use an account; cross-device style-data sync is not enabled in this build.
profile.coveragePreferenceHint: Choose this yourself. AI Beauty never infers coverage or modesty from your photo, country or identity.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Showing offline suggestions instead.
errors.cameraPermission: Camera access is needed for this feature.
errors.photoPermission: Photo access is needed for this feature.
errors.locationPermission: Location access is needed for automatic weather.

subscription.sandboxNotice: No billing provider is configured yet — this runs in local sandbox mode, so you can test the paywall without any real charge.
subscription.loadError: Plans could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
subscription.purchaseError: Purchase could not be completed. You were not charged.
subscription.restoreNone: No active Plus purchase was found for this store account.
subscription.restoreError: Purchases could not be restored. Check your connection and try again.
subscription.runwayPlusBody: Runway video recording is included with AI Beauty Plus.
subscription.storePlusBody: Advanced in-store decision support is included with AI Beauty Plus.

sharing.shareText: My look for today, styled by AI Beauty.

auth.googleNotConfigured: Google sign-in isn't configured in this build yet.
auth.appleNotConfigured: Apple sign-in needs a backend and a native build — not available in this build yet.
auth.localOnlyNotice: No backend is configured yet, so this account stays on this device only.
auth.invalidCredentials: That email or password isn't right.
auth.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.

runway.title: Runway
runway.subtitle: Capture a runway-style photo and preview a look style on it.
runway.permissionBody: Runway needs camera access and, for video, microphone permission. You can change this in device settings.
runway.recordError: The video could not be recorded. Please try again.
runway.readyBody: Your short clip was saved locally. AI analysis is not shown unless a real analysis provider returns a result.

outfit.breathable: Breathable layers that work indoors or out.
outfit.hotSafety: Lightweight, sweat-wicking fabric with sun protection for exposed skin.
outfit.hotNormal: Lightweight, breathable fabric in a lighter shade to stay cool.
outfit.warm: A light layer you can remove — comfortable for most of the day.
outfit.coldSafety: Insulated technical layers, covering extremities, with grip-appropriate footwear.
outfit.coldNormal: A structured coat and a warm base layer.
outfit.rainySafety: Water-resistant outer layer and shoes with real tread — skip anything that loses grip when wet.
outfit.rainyNormal: A water-resistant outer layer, and shoes that won't be ruined by rain.
outfit.snowy: Waterproof, insulated footwear with traction, and layered insulation.
outfit.windy: A fitted outer layer that won't catch the wind, secured accessories.
outfit.crossfit: Secure-fitting functional wear, supportive training shoes, hair fully controlled, minimal jewelry — nothing that can catch or swing during dynamic movement.
outfit.gymWeights: Fitted-but-flexible training wear suited for {{session}}, stable-soled shoes.
outfit.pilatesYoga: Soft, stretch-friendly fabric, low-profile accessories, hair kept out of the face.
outfit.hiit: Moisture-wicking, secure-fit activewear, supportive shoes, minimal jewelry.
outfit.running: Technical running fabric, shoes with good traction for the conditions, minimal loose accessories.
outfit.cycling: Fitted, wind-resistant activewear, closed supportive shoes, no loose scarves or long straps.
outfit.outdoorTraining: Weather-layered activewear with grip-appropriate footwear for the terrain.
outfit.swimming: Practical swimwear and a simple cover-up, water shoes for uneven terrain.
outfit.recoveryMobility: Loose, comfortable fabric that doesn't restrict stretching.
outfit.walking: Comfortable supportive shoes and easy layers you can adjust as you warm up.

skinPrep.sun: Lightweight hydration + SPF — non-negotiable given today's sun exposure.
skinPrep.normal: Light hydration and a thin SPF layer before anything else.

lookEngine.complexion: A {{intensity}} base — even, not heavy, letting skin texture show through.
lookEngine.eyesSafety: Smudge-proof, minimal — built to last through movement.
lookEngine.eyesGlamSmoky: A defined smoky wash with clean liner.
lookEngine.eyesSoft: A soft wash of neutral tone with clean liner.
lookEngine.brows: Brushed up, natural shape, no harsh lines.
lookEngine.blushBarelyThere: Barely-there flush on the cheeks for warmth.
lookEngine.blush: A {{intensity}} flush on the cheeks for warmth.
lookEngine.lipsGlam: A bold, saturated lip to anchor the look.
lookEngine.lipsDefault: A hydrating tint close to your natural lip color.
lookEngine.hairSafety: Secured away from the face — braid, low bun or ponytail depending on length.
lookEngine.hairDefault: Natural waves or a low-effort style that matches today's energy.
lookEngine.grooming: Clean lines, light beard oil if applicable, groomed brows.
lookEngine.nailsSafety: Short and practical for today's activity.
lookEngine.nailsDefault: A neutral or soft color that won't compete with the rest of the look.
lookEngine.accessoriesSafety: Minimal to none — nothing that can catch, swing, or distract during activity.
lookEngine.accessoriesDelicate: A delicate piece or two — let the outfit lead.
lookEngine.accessoriesConsidered: A considered piece or two — let the outfit lead.
lookEngine.whySafety: — with safety and practicality taking priority over styling today
lookEngine.whyZodiac: A small {{sign}} touch ({{keyword}}) is woven into the accent color.

specialOccasion.withPlan: For {{plan}}, keep the {{style}} direction but elevate one focal detail and keep the rest intentional.
specialOccasion.default: Use the {{style}} direction as the base, then elevate one focal detail for the occasion.

lookEngine.shopping: Shop only for a real gap: choose one piece that strengthens your {{style}} direction and works with at least three items you already own.

coverage.more_coverage: Keep the silhouette more covered while preserving the style direction.
coverage.balanced: Use a balanced amount of coverage and ease.
coverage.more_open: A more open silhouette is welcome where practical and appropriate.

coverageWhy.more_coverage: your explicit preference for more coverage
coverageWhy.more_open: your explicit preference for a more open silhouette

notifications.savedLookBody: Open your Saved Looks and reuse a favorite instead of buying something new.

privacy.photoAiBody: If you continue, photos used for selfie styling, Fit Check or closet analysis may be sent to the configured AI backend for that request. Photos stay in app-owned storage on this device unless you explicitly save/share them. You can revoke this permission in Profile.
privacy.photoAiSettingHint: Allow locally stored photos to be sent to the configured AI backend when a photo-based feature needs them.
